notes.title: Version 2.27 is here. Ready to save the Earth?
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! We have uploaded version 2.27 of Elva the Eco Dragon.

- Better controllers with enhanced smooth movements.
- Now you can change the Y axis on config.
- Reposition Elva to her original point while playing (R, right stick click).
- Recompiled textures for better view and HDR active.
- These changes are active now on Steam and Nintendo Switch.

And more things to come soon. Thank you!

notes.title: Elva the Eco Dragon final version is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/5bdfef9f6c2a458bd5e18fa6d50d2d5044027fee.jpg

"Elva the Eco Dragon" final trailer is here.

"Elva the Eco Dragon"final version is now available!

Many inputs from you and many changes will be available in the game, so you can learn how to save the planet helping Elva.

In this short video you can see some of the most important new features we have added to "Elva the Eco Dragon". In short, cleaning debris is now an important part of the game, but we must also discover books, save wild animals, and even use our EcoRay to clean debris. But the most important thing are maybe the new "Superpowers", like cleaning an area just in seconds, or planting forests and gardens with just movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/7e7d53fb16cdf398a45f4de5b601b5d0bef965fc.png

The game also features a brand new ocean area where the player must save different animals of the sea. 

Now the game has been adapted for 4K monitors, and you can play at that resolution. This video has been captured that way

[previewyoutube=HhH2TPNwLCA;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we are preparing new scenarios, the first one in space to clean the space debris will arrive very soon.

Show the children that we can clean and save the planet. This game intends to show that our planet is beautiful, and we must protect it. Your help will be invaluable to us.

We' re going to release new videos that are now recorded with tons of new features. Please stay tuned and don't forget to clean your city, your village, your world.

Thank you!
